new_for_file.brief: Creates a `GtkIconPaintable` for a file with a given size and scale.
new_for_file.md:
Creates a `GtkIconPaintable` for a file with a given size and scale.

The icon can then be rendered by using it as a `GdkPaintable`.

doc.brief: Contains information found when looking up an icon in `GtkIconTheme` or loading it from a file.
doc.md:
Contains information found when looking up an icon in `GtkIconTheme`
or loading it from a file.

`GtkIconPaintable` implements `GdkPaintable` and `GtkSymbolicPaintable`.

get_file.brief: Gets the `GFile` that was used to load the icon.
get_file.md:
Gets the `GFile` that was used to load the icon.

Returns `NULL` if the icon was not loaded from a file.

get_icon_name.brief: Get the icon name being used for this icon.
get_icon_name.md:
Get the icon name being used for this icon.

When an icon looked up in the icon theme was not available, the
icon theme may use fallback icons - either those specified to
gtk_icon_theme_lookup_icon() or the always-available
"image-missing". The icon chosen is returned by this function.

If the icon was created without an icon theme, this function
returns `NULL`.

is_symbolic.brief: Checks if the icon is symbolic or not.
is_symbolic.md:
Checks if the icon is symbolic or not.

This currently uses only the file name and not the file contents
for determining this. This behaviour may change in the future.

file.brief: The file representing the icon, if any.
file.md: The file representing the icon, if any.

icon-name.brief: The icon name that was chosen during lookup.
icon-name.md: The icon name that was chosen during lookup.

is-symbolic.brief: Whether the icon is symbolic or not.
is-symbolic.md: Whether the icon is symbolic or not.
